name: John Wayne Airport, Orange County

runway.v: main runway 5,700 ft (about 1,737 m), used by airlines and general aviation; a 2,887 ft runway serves general aviation
runway.quote: the 5,700-foot main runway serves both commercial and general aviation aircraft

curfew.v: no outright night ban for general aviation, but a mandatory night noise limit: departures 22:00-07:00 and arrivals 23:00-07:00 (to 08:00 on Sundays) must stay within about 86.7 to 87.6 dB SENEL at the airport's south monitoring stations (86.9 dB at the north stations); violation is a misdemeanor; check the aircraft's noise data before any night movement
curfew.quote: No person shall operate any general aviation aircraft at night at John Wayne Airport ...

noise.v: GANO compliance is mandatory; daytime limits 101.1-102.5 dB SENEL, night limits 86.7-87.6 dB SENEL at the monitoring stations; daytime is Mon-Sat 07:00-22:00 departures and 07:00-23:00 arrivals, Sundays from 08:00; three violations in three years can bar the owner, operator and aircraft for three years; older types (e.g. Gulfstream II/IIB/III, Learjet 23-29, HS125 with Viper engines) are presumed unable to comply and may not use the airport except in an emergency

max_aircraft.v: aircraft presumed unable to meet GANO limits (including Gulfstream II, IIB, III; Learjet 23, 24, 25, 28, 29; HS125-1A-600 with Viper engines; Jetstar II; Piaggio P180) may not land, take off or be based at the airport, except in an emergency; FBO general aviation aprons take aircraft up to 100,000 lb maximum certificated gross take-off weight (dual gear) with wingspans under 100 ft
max_aircraft.quote: are presumed incapable of meeting noise limitations defined in the GANO and are not permitted to land, tie down, takeoff or be based at the Airport, except in an emergency

handling.v: two full-service FBOs: ACI Jet and Clay Lacy Aviation

hours.v: general aviation may operate 24 hours a day, subject to the noise limits
hours.quote: General aviation aircraft are permitted to operate at JWA 24 hours per day

fuel.v: fuelling listed at ACI Jet and Clay Lacy Aviation; fuel types not given

slots.v: Commercial Air Carriers (regularly scheduled service) need allocated average daily departures (ADDs), including for their charter flights; the plan text read sets no slot rule for general aviation
slots.quote: all Commercial Air Carrier Class A and permanent Class E departures at JWA are regulated departures
